title: phux plugin index
description: Static catalog of phux plugins discovered from public GitHub repositories tagged phux-plugin and from the in-repo examples. Plugins run as the user and aren't sandboxed (see docs/plugins.md).

schema_version.description: Index document version. Adding, removing, or renaming a field bumps this value, including an additive field.

generated_at.description: UTC time the file was built, to the second.

notice.description: How a plugin runs once installed.
notice.const: Plugins run as the user and aren't sandboxed (see docs/plugins.md).

skipped.description: Repositories and directories left out of plugins, with the reason.

subdir.description: Plugin directory relative to the repository root. Empty when phux-plugin.toml is at the root.

description.description: Manifest description, or an empty string when the manifest omits it. Capped at 500 characters.

kinds.description: Manifest sections that declare something. Order is fixed.

stars.description: GitHub stargazer count, or null when repository metadata was not available.

pushed_at.description: GitHub pushed_at, or null when repository metadata was not available.

license.description: SPDX license id reported by GitHub, or null.

subdir.description: Plugin directory, or empty when the whole repository was skipped.

reason.description: Why this repository or directory is not in plugins. archived, fork, private, no valid manifest, or invalid manifest/directory text. Capped at 300 characters.
